question: dame los diez países con MAYOR TASA de aprobación, con su tasa en porcentaje, contando solo los que tengan al menos mil intentos
sql:
SELECT ref_country.country_name, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN fact_payment_attempt.auth_status = 'approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS approval_rate_pct
FROM fact_payment_attempt
JOIN ref_country ON fact_payment_attempt.geo_country = ref_country.country_code
GROUP BY ref_country.country_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000
ORDER BY approval_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 10
